questions.stem: Human rights are described as inherent. This means that these rights

options.A: apply to everyone regardless of race, sex and religion.
options.B: apply to all humans because they are human.

questions.answerNote: Answer key on page 21 of the source PDF lists Question 1 as B.

questions.stem: Why are young offenders treated differently to adult offenders in the criminal justice system?

options.A: It is required by international law
options.B: Young offenders do not reoffend as often as adults
options.C: The offences they commit are usually not as serious
options.D: They are less likely to understand the consequences of their actions

questions.answerNote: Answer key on page 21 of the source PDF lists Question 2 as D.
